set.body: Filed per chief's P0-3 ACCEPT-WITH-NITS (post-01M15755P9QSXWK20A0VWMHDWF). Scope: extend HsmmResult.validated to take the Candidates (with channel provenance) and require every anchored key to be a nominated candidate for its unit (or an ancestor admitted by hierarchy policy); codec decodes HsmmResult only with recall + view + candidates. Owner: claude-storymodel4s-m1 with codex-storymodel4s-root (codec). Not blocking W4.
set.title: Follow-up: candidates as part of the HsmmResult proof — validated cannot yet prove a faithful anchor was a nominated candidate (a caller may place faithful mass on a non-contradicted non-candidate); design together with the codec decode path (decode would need Candidates)
